expectations.text: Separates repeated status gathering/drafting from stakeholder negotiation and plan decisions, keeping the latter human-led.
expectations.evidence: Source: “conversations often change the plan.” Output: “Keep the priority conversations with you” and “Preserve the conversations, relationships and decisions that change the plan.”

expectations.text: Preserves Priya’s valuable diagnostic practice and the migration owner’s delivery responsibility.
expectations.evidence: Source: Priya “explicitly values the practice”; leader “should not take their delivery decisions away.” Output: “Preserve diagnosis and ownership practice” and “leaving delivery decisions with them.”

expectations.text: Uses the supplied baseline as about 40 active minutes weekly, or the exact four observations; does not invent saved hours or measured assisted performance.
expectations.evidence: Source: 40, 35, 45 and 40 active minutes; review/maintenance unmeasured. Output: “40 active minutes per Friday on average” and “no net saving is established.”

expectations.text: Chooses one feasible trial from pasted status excerpts with clear AI output, leader ownership, technical review and a condition to stop or revise.
expectations.evidence: Output: “numbered 1–5”; “short stakeholder update ... plus a claim-to-source checklist”; “You own the update and its final approval”; “An engineer checks technical factual details”; “Stop or adjust it if unsupported claims recur.”

expectations.text: Proposes comparing actual manual and assisted effort including review or maintenance plus quality/rework, tied to more room for coaching rather than automatic extra work.
expectations.evidence: Output: “record source gathering/pasting, drafting, review, corrections and prompt upkeep separately”; “measure a manual full cycle”; “Include the engineer’s review effort, factual errors and rework”; “deliberately use some for coaching.”

actionability.firstUsefulAction: “Choose the Friday stakeholder-update first draft as your first AI experiment.” The first trial action is to start with one historical Friday’s five numbered excerpts.
unnecessaryRepetition: Human ownership of stakeholder conversations, Priya’s practice and migration decisions appears in the work table and is restated in the following opportunity paragraph.
The opening recommendation, first table row and ranked-opportunities sentence all identify update drafting as the same first candidate.
actionability.notes: A complete, feasible recommendation with explicit source grounding and a sound distinction between the measured preparation baseline and unmeasured full-cycle savings. The table makes the alternatives reviewable, but the repeated recommendation and ownership language make it longer than necessary. No material omission.
